response.overview: In this classic Nigerian comedy, wealthy businessman Baba Sala finds himself caught in a whirlwind of family disputes, romantic entanglements and financial troubles. As his life becomes increasingly intertwined with that of fellow businessman Mosebolatan, hidden relationships and clashing social expectations threaten to complicate matters. A humorous exploration of greed, love, class and family life in Nigerian society.
response.title: Mosebolatan
